# Worked example: solving a problem by composition {#sec-worked-example-composition}

*A companion to the week-ten worked-example lecture and its snippet-cast recording.*

::: {.callout-note}
## Draft stub — planned contents
Records a small biology problem solved live from a blank page: deciding the decomposition into named functions, writing each, testing it, hitting a bug, reading the error, and fixing it. The point is to model the whole process of putting the pieces together, which is the skill that lags behind understanding the pieces, so that students can replay it at home and then do the week's project themselves.
:::
